title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments-Structure and Response of Spherical Diffusion Flames
objectives: Investigate spherical diffusion-flame structure, extinction, and possible dynamic instabilities in microgravity.
approach: Test gaseous fuels and diluents under varied conditions, studying soot-free and sooty flames as they evolve.
